tool.title: Keep a note on the work
tool.description: Keep a short note on the work you are doing — what you did, what you decided and why, and what is left open — so it is there when the work is picked up again.

inputs.name: note
inputs.description: The note, in plain words. One paragraph is plenty.

inputs.name: shared
inputs.description: true: the memory you share with the other agents working with you. Default: your own memory of this work.

$comment.comment: Its own Tool group, outside the sdlc and beans sub-graphs, so a run can offer memory to an agent told nothing about the work plan (owner, 2026-11-03, cat-harness#991 Q11/Q14/Q17, proposal §4.13-4.14: "would an agent still see it through dependency tree... in that case it needs to be own tool"). Everything the agent reads here is neutral on purpose; check:context-leak scans it. Behind it the entry is kept through the memory store (a bean, with its metadata wrapped by the server) chosen by the deployment's stores["work-context"]; the launcher binds the session with CAT_WORK_INSTANCE, CAT_MEMORY_SHARED and CAT_AGENT_ID (cat-harness-tools#1438).
